588942.name: Chabad of Oswego
588942.note: Lubavitch.com, 6 Aug 2008 ('Oswego: On Small Town Campus, Chabad Draws Jewish Students In'): bringing Jewish pride and knowledge to the SUNY Oswego campus 'is why Rabbi Yossi and Chana Madvig, recipients of a Rohr Family Foundation grant, moved upstate in October' (October 2007); 'They arrived in Oswego at the urging of an incoming SUNY student'. Its chabad.org listing went up 1 Nov 2007.

6699193.name: Chabad of Geneseo
6699193.note: CrownHeights.info, 24 June 2025 ('New Vibrant Jewish Presence For Top-Ranked Public College'): 'Rabbi Laivy and Goldy Mochkin, along with their four children, have launched the first permanent Jewish infrastructure at SUNY Geneseo'; 'Geneseo now celebrates a new chapter of Jewish life.' CrownHeights.info, 9 Apr 2025: they are among '35 New Shluchim' receiving grants ('Rabbi Laivy & Mrs. Goldy Mochkin – Chabad of SUNY Geneseo'). Its chabad.org listing went up 1 Jan 2025.

3293464.name: Chabad of Cortland
3293464.note: CrownHeights.info, 20 Dec 2023 ('Help Chabad at Cortland Expand!'): 'Chabad at Cortland has been operating for over eight years out of a rented family home a few blocks from campus.' Medium: counted back (over eight years before Dec 2023, so 2015 or a little earlier); its chabad.org listing went up 6 Apr 2016. Director: Mendel Hecht.
